items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: She was working with Billy Eckstine's band.

ctx.x: The Last Word. That was on Central. The Last Word was one. Then there were a couple of places across the street. Then further out on Central, Joe Morris opened a place called the Plantation, and he had big bands in there. That's when I first met Sarah Vaughan. That was back there. She was working with Billy Eckstine's band.
